summary: Full end-to-end testing of RCA rent calculator: 17/17 backend pytest cases pass (default sample, formula, norma detection incl. boundaries, zile_facturate cap warning, no-overlap warning, culpa periods, holidays inside repair window, price abuse true/false). Frontend Playwright covers: page load, Calculeaza -> KPIs (15, 5.445,00, 39.347,19), cronologie 15 rows, letter contains required strings, Copiaza clicks, Email button present, HolidayManager add+remove with localStorage persistence, dark-mode toggle, reset-form-button restores defaults.
critical_code_review_comments: calc.py: `inceput_reparatie` flag is set True then immediately checked; the `if not inceput_reparatie: continue` branch is dead code (has no effect on output). Minor cleanup, not a bug.
server.py: CalcRequest.zile_facturate is typed float but coerced with int(to_float(...)) in calc.py -- fine, but could be Field annotated. No functional issue.
No API-level input sanitization for date format beyond parse_date fallback; invalid dates silently become None which yields warning -- acceptable stateless behaviour.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite at /app/backend/tests/test_rca_calc.py covers default sample + all edge cases in the review request. Frontend selectors used are all data-testid based and stable.
